name: networking-design
description: Network design for cloud / hybrid / on-prem. VPC / VNet / VPC structure, subnet segmentation (public / private / data), CIDR planning, routing, peering / Transit Gateway / hub-spoke, NAT + egress control, DNS strategy (Route53 / Cloud DNS / Azure DNS), private endpoints for managed services, load balancers (L4 / L7 / global), CDN, VPN + Direct Connect for on-prem, service mesh network topology. Mermaid diagrams with optional PNG export.
